usage: 星期五 is used as a noun to indicate the fifth day of the week.
It can act as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about days or plans.
You can use 星期五 with time expressions, like '下星期五' to say 'next Friday'.
It often appears in phrases related to scheduling or weekly routines.
星期五 can also be combined with verbs to talk about activities on that day.

examples.meaning: I have to work on Friday.
